scope: Four 100-update arms share an unclipped token IS objective: baseline, Max, Pro causal prefix mask, Max+Pro. One seed. Prior ICEPOP and PPO-clipped runs are separate archives.
baseline_definition: Unclipped token IS surrogate: mean(current/rollout ratio * RLOO advantage), no learned trust-region mask and no extra IS multiplier.
pro_definition: Multiply the same token IS surrogate by a detached causal prefix geometric-mean mask computed from current/rollout ratio, thresholds [0.5,5]. No PPO clipping and no extra IS multiplier.
